items.summary: The National Academy of Direct Taxes–Regional Campus, Mumbai (NADT-RC, Mumbai) and the National Institute of Securities Markets, Mumbai (NISM, Mumbai) today entered onto a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) to promote academic cooperation, specialized training, research and professional capacity building.
items.title: NADT-RC, Mumbai and NISM, Mumbai sign MoU to Promote Academic Cooperation and Capacity Building
